context: Clarifying the difference between rule and governance
purpose: Define key terms; teach 支配/民主/集団/司法/民族/態度/長官

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先生、支配と統治って違うんですか？
lines.en: Teacher, are domination and governance different?
lines.style: curious teen asking a precise question

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: いい質問です。力で抑えるのが支配に近い。
lines.en: Good question. Suppressing by force is closer to domination.
lines.style: teacher praising and explaining carefully, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 民主では、集団の合意が土台になりますね。
lines.en: In democracy, group consensus is the base.
lines.style: student building on the definition, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう、そして司法がそれを守ります。
lines.en: Right, and the judiciary protects it.
lines.style: teacher affirming and extending the point

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 少数民族の権利はどう守られるんですか？
lines.en: How are minority peoples’ rights protected?
lines.style: conscientious teen pressing on fairness, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 法の下では、誰もが平等という態度が原則です。
lines.en: Under law, the principle is an attitude of equality.
lines.style: teacher articulating a foundational value, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 行政の長官にも、説明責任がありますね。
lines.style: student noting institutional duty, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence
